about: Shell texts the design copy deck lacks. Each is written into the four Shell catalogs (packages/shell/src/i18n/catalogs/<lang>.json) exactly as here. The fa and ckb texts are drafts for the owner's own review (owner decision O6: listed in reports under Owner steps (not blocking), never waited for); debug.* texts are English in all four languages on purpose, like every S15 debug menu text in the deck (test builds only), so they need no review. copy-deck.mjs keys/apply/check --extras reads this file; references/translation-workflow.md shows the same table. The copy deck itself is never edited here.
